notice: Pre-registered before any Sprint 9O competence run. Cases, order, arms and pass bar are fixed here; later changes are appended to amendments with a date and reason, and earlier results are kept. Brand and territory names are inputs only: nothing in the runtime reads this file (AGENTS generalization rules).

new.description: Sprint 9O engine: runtime reference discovery (build_comparison_set v5)

before.description: the same engine with the runtime reference discovery off (the model searches references alone, as in production at 657a2b4)

budget.rule: Cases run in order. A case starts only if the remaining live allowance covers 30 dispatches for both arms; otherwise it and all later cases are NOT_RUN. Calls shared by both arms are served from the case's recording, so both arms see identical Qloo answers.

cases.kind: previously measured live (Sprint 9L: credible stretch, provisional)
recorded live failure (L-M1: 7 empty reference probes)

metrics.measured: the target territory has FULL_RELATIVE_ANALYSIS with a classification and a numeric relative position
metrics.semanticallyValid: every measured comparison set passed the semantic comparison validator
metrics.emptyProbeRate: brand-independent recommend calls that returned no eligible entity / all brand-independent recommend calls
metrics.honestUnmeasured: an unmeasured run's decision card names why (blocker or limitation) and a next action
metrics.safety: unsupported classifications 0, decision-card violations 0, cross-call comparisons 0

passBar.safety: every run of both arms meets safety (any violation fails the evaluation)
passBar.competence: the new arm measures the target in at least half of the cases it completed, with every measured set semantically valid
passBar.improvement: the new arm measures at least as many cases as the before arm on identical Qloo answers, and is reported with its Qloo cost per measured case
passBar.honesty: every unmeasured run of the new arm is honestUnmeasured
